# SoloLakehouse agent entrypoint

Read [AGENTS](../AGENTS.md) before work, then [roadmap](../docs/roadmap.md)
for scope and [TASKS](../TASKS.md) for the next task ID, dependencies, output
and acceptance. Use the [construction plan](../docs/design/v3/README.md) for
relevant design detail and [CLAUDE](../CLAUDE.md) for retained code patterns.

Follow AGENTS' start/handoff protocol. Update TASKS with observed checks,
evidence, gaps and next ID in the same PR. Keep this file a pointer, without
duplicate status or a separate backlog. Preserve reference behavior, private
configuration and historical originals; a planned task does not authorize
deployment, host changes, migration or file/data deletion.
